reviews.title: WORST APP AND NON EXISTENT CUSTOMER SERVICE EXPERIENCE I’VE EVER HAD
reviews.text:
If I could give OurTime zero stars, I would.

This is genuinely one of the worst apps I have ever tried to use, but the app itself isn’t even the most frustrating part. The customer service is practically nonexistent.

I have contacted customer service MULTIPLE times trying to get help and have received nothing but automated responses. No actual person addressing the problem. No meaningful assistance. No resolution. Just automated messages that accomplish absolutely nothing.

For a DATING APP that collects and stores extremely personal information, photographs, messages, preferences, and profile information, you would think customers would at least have access to competent human support when something goes wrong. Apparently not.

I have become so frustrated with this company that I no longer even want an account. I have now requested that OurTime permanently delete my account and remove my personal information from their system.

It is astonishing to me that a company can charge people for a service while making actual customer service this difficult to obtain.

I’ve used plenty of apps over the years and have dealt with plenty of companies. I cannot remember another app experience that has made me this angry and frustrated.

Absolutely terrible experience. I would NOT recommend OurTime.

Additionally, I’ve experienced many profiles that you can clearly tell are of fake identities, scammers, or people catfishing. Also, while my profile is specifically sent to a man seeking a man, I continue to receive profiles of women in my feed. Whether these people are paid or not paid subscribers, I haven’t kept track of.  
My overall recommendation is unless you live in a major metropolitan city, I do not recommend this app for those seeking same sex relationships.

I get message notifications via email, click the “see what they said” link up to 20 times and app opens without going into message- no place in app to just read messages. No place on app to search a particular user. Have used many dating apps, find this one is hair trigger to perceive a swipe and you cannot undo a swipe right leafing to awkward “matches” you cannot undo just have to block. Cannot find help articles or support for questions like “why can’tI see my messages?”. Notifications for someone liking you work just as poorly as messages- click the “see if you like them too” link repeatedly and it doesn’t work. So much frustration, not worth yor time.

reviews.title: HUGE SCAM
reviews.text: Whatever you do, do not purchase this app. DO NOT put any of your information on this app. Once you sign up they will sell your information and photos and the next thing you know another online profile will be created of you on another site by a scammer who is pretending to be you. After you set up your profile they will block your access to your account and will not respond to your request as to why you were blocked. I set up an account and within an hour before I could even use the account my access was blocked. Within three hours my account was duplicated and all of my pictures and bio was on a different site and being run by a scammer. Our time clearly has a data breach and does not care about its customers or protecting their information.

reviews.title: Filters don’t seem to work
reviews.text:
I thought this app would be better because it tailors to an older age group. 
However, there are several issues that I do not like. 1. It will not filter out certain relationship statuses. I do not want to date someone who is “currently separated“ and no matter how I try to use the “dealbreaker” button, they keep coming through. 
2. I would like to search based on location, or see a more menu like approach, rather than the app choose whose profile I see. It will not let me scroll without deciding yes or no. I dislike that knee jerk “Tinder“ mindset. 
3. The majority of suggestions are live either in Canada, or are hundreds of miles away. I do live in a rural area, but suggestions of someone two states and six hours away is not helpful. 

I will be cancelling my membership. 

I wish there was a way to switch platforms to Match which does seem to allow users to limit distances while searching.

reviews.title: If I could only give no stars
reviews.text: Problems with glitching, lost messages, inaccurate match info ( being matched with someone whose profile I’ve never seen, sent profiles that I’ve already messaged), members not receiving messages I’ve sent, horrible customer service repose (only repetitive computer generated messages), and a lot of fake profiles with no information and unrealistic photos. Actually locked me out my account by claiming my phone number could not be verified during the time I planned to cancel Membership. I met my late husband on match and thought this would be a great place to meet people in a new state. I plan on contacting the BBB, FTC, and Representative of State to report poor business practice and false advertising.

reviews.title: Useless unless you pay
reviews.text: This app is terrible and only out to make money. Matching seemed easier here with potentially compatible people BUT when you get an email telling you that match messaged you when you go back into app it locks the person so you cannot see them or their profile and cannot read and respond to message….Unless you become a subscriber! Some apps will at least lure you in by allowing some initial interactions. So, ultimately, you don’t know if that person thinks you aren’t interested. It’s useless unless you are willing to pay. I have “paid my dues” on more than one of these apps with no success so I’m not eager to do that again.

reviews.title: Faulty design
reviews.text:
If I could give this app a zero I would. The design of this app is terrible. I have accidentally swiped right or left on so many profiles just trying to scroll up in order to read the entire profile. They need to have a better design.

I also created the account on my iPad and it takes FOREVER for photos to be approved. And I can’t sign in on my phone because I can’t pass their little “test.” I don’t even understand the instructions for it. I don’t see those kinds of things well even with my glasses anyway. When two of my photos were approved, I tried over and over to rearrange them to move one of them into the primary spot. I went back in no photo was showing up in the primary spot. I finally deleted the account if they can’t show me it’s a good app on the free version. I’m certainly not paying for it 👎

reviews.title: Worse than Plenty of Fish if that’s even possible!!
reviews.text: Don’t waste your time or money on this app. You can’t even see who’s viewed you or messaged you without paying for a membership. Even once you do, every other features they have will make it necessary for you to make yet another purchase . The suggestions it makes for you are nowhere near the parameters you are asked to provide. Nobody on here is a real person. They send you messages from people who never intend to even try and connect with you. This has been the worst experience I’ve had since I jumped back into dating sites. Again, don’t waste your time or money on it! It’s not worth your time and aggravation.
